visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A close-up shot shows a hand holding a maroon pen, writing ingredients in Traditional Chinese on a white notepad. To the left is an open cookbook with a picture of bread. The lighting is bright and natural, highlighting the white paper and handwriting. (2) The woman stands in her kitchen, holding a large stainless steel mixing bowl. She wears a cream-colored top. Behind her, a KitchenAid mixer sits on the counter. The kitchen is modern and clean with white cabinetry and a gas stove visible. (3) On a marble countertop, the woman uses a brown scraper to divide a large piece of dough into smaller portions. She then rolls them into smooth round balls using both hands, showing meticulous movement and focus. (4) A close-up shot of a food processor mixing yellow ingredients. A white spatula scrapes down the sides of the bowl. Later, she mixes toppings in a stainless steel bowl with an orange spatula, focusing on the texture of the filling. (5) The woman arranges dozens of dough balls on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper. She uses a silicone brush to apply a golden egg wash over each bun carefully, ensuring even coverage for baking. (6) The woman uses scissors to snip the tops of the buns. She sprinkles almond slices and pipes yellow cream. She adds chopped green scallions and meat floss as toppings to the baked buns, demonstrating a variety of flavors. (7) A tray of golden brown buns is pulled out of the oven. A close-up shows hands pulling one bun away from the rest, revealing the soft, fluffy interior texture of the bread and the melted toppings.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 上週做「培根起司麵包」. (2) [Subtitle]: 女兒說：這次你要做什麼啊？. (3) [Subtitle]: 這種被需要的感覺 雖然有一點累. (4) [Variety]: 菠蘿皮完成. (5) [Subtitle]: 但甜甜的感覺 還是比較多. (6) [Variety]: 奶酥完成. (7) [Subtitle]: 只是女兒不吃大蒜 兒子不吃奶酥. (8) [Subtitle]: 我腸胃不好 只能吃的清淡. (9) [Subtitle]: 老公隨便都可以 要找交集有一點難. (10) [Subtitle]: 問問自己為什麼 想要滿足每一個人呢？ (11) [Subtitle]: 因為我不喜歡勉強吃 不愛吃的東西. (12) [Subtitle]: 所以我也希望 有人這麼體貼我吧. (13) [Subtitle]: 做他們喜歡吃的 看孩子吃得開心. (14) [Variety]: 蔥花餡料完成. (15) [Subtitle]: 我可以高興好幾天. (16) [Variety]: 大蒜醬完成. (17) [Subtitle]: 媽媽真的潛力無窮. (18) [Subtitle]: 我沒生小孩之前 我根本不覺得 我是這樣的媽媽. (19) [Subtitle]: 這一大盤麵包 就是媽媽的霸氣表現. (20) [Subtitle]: 肉鬆 大蒜 蔥花 奶酥 菠蘿 漢堡麵包. (21) [Subtitle]: 出爐的時候 超有成就感的. (22) [Subtitle]: 女兒看到的時候就說 wow 真的什麼口味都有耶. (23) [Subtitle]: 他就挑一挑 扒了好幾顆去學校了. (24) [Subtitle]: 食譜放在留言區 記得去看喔.

(2) Discrete sound of a pen scratching on paper occurs as she logs the recipe. (3) A sharp click of a mixing bowl locking into place followed by the low hum of a KitchenAid mixer. (4) Percussive thuds and a muffled slapping sound are heard as dough is manipulated on a marble counter, accompanied by the metallic strike of a bench scraper. (5) High-pitched popping sound effects signify visual cuts between different ingredient preparations. (6) Sound of rapid knife chops on wood for scallions, followed by a metallic click of a garlic press. (7) Soft plastic rustling sounds as a piping bag is handled. (8) A metallic clatter of the oven door and a sliding sound on a wire rack. (9) A soft tearing sound of the fresh bread crust, concluding with the narrator's warm final remarks.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video combines a baking tutorial with personal storytelling to show how a mother prepares a variety of breads to satisfy the differing tastes of her family members. It highlights the labor of love in domestic life and provides a sense of accomplishment through food.
